title: Hadith on Daily Acts of Charity
summary: Every joint must perform an act of charity daily.
translation: Narrated from Abu Huraira, and this is an agreed-upon hadith, meaning both Bukhari and Muslim have narrated it, that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: 'Every person must give charity for each joint each day the sun rises. To judge fairly between two people is charity. To help a man with his mount, lifting him onto it or hoisting up his belongings onto it, is charity. A good word is charity. Every step you take towards prayer is charity. And removing a harmful object from the road is charity.' The Prophet (peace be upon him) explains that for each joint in the human body, a person should perform charity each day. This does not necessarily mean giving money. Instead, fair judgement, aiding someone with transportation, saying a kind word, walking to prayer, and clearing the path are all acts of charity.
